1.Title: Obsiornis' Blessing
1.Rule: Seasonal environments are only valid for the current season.

2.Rule: Seasonal environments apply in the following Golden Frontier game modes: City Sieges, Vanguard War, and Arms Mobilization battles.

3.Rule: Detailed numerical values for seasonal environment effects can be viewed on the Formations page.

4.Rule: Seasonal hero bonuses only apply in Golden Frontier game modes.

5.Rule: Seasonal hero bonuses apply in City Siege, Vanguard War, and Arms Mobilization battles.

6.Rule: Only 1 seasonal hero bonus can take effect for each team. When multiple heroes are present, the bonus will be applied to the hero with the highest tier.
